Our exclusive Runway Secrets menu provides clients with cutting-edge makeup artistry, trendy hair color, natural hair care services and advanced skin care solutions. Our extensively trained salon experts work tirelessly to bring the most updated techniques and trends to our customers through our curated portfolio of services. We provide the highest quality of service, tailored to exceed our customers' expectations, and make every visit a memorable one. With our commitment to safety and impeccable hygiene standards, Lakmē Salon is here to offer you the best pampering experience

customer_updates.name: Jai Kasekar
customer_updates.text: I did my haircut from hairstylist harshal. Got a complete new look. Thanks to her.

featured_reviews.name: Jyoti Soni
featured_reviews.review_text: Got my gel extensions done for the first time at Lakmé Academy, and I couldn’t be happier! Huge shoutout to Ms. Sapna and Gudan for doing such a fabulous job. It was their first time doing gel extensions, and they absolutely nailed it—as you can see in the picture! Totally loved the result ✨💅 thank you

featured_reviews.name: Riyaz Ansari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Lakme Salon Sion West and had a really satisfying experience.
Vishal did an excellent pedicure with great care and attention – very smooth, clean and relaxing service.
Swara handled the cleanup beautifully. She was very patient and made sure everything was done properly. My skin feels light and fresh after the session.
The team is friendly, the place is well maintained and the service feels truly premium.
Will definitely visit again and recommend this branch to others! 🌟😊

featured_reviews.name: Ali Ishraque
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing experience at Lakme Salon Sion West.
Special thanks to Vishal for the pedicure – very professional, hygienic and relaxing service. My feet feel fresh and clean.
Also big thanks to Jayesh for the haircut – he understood exactly what I wanted and gave me a perfect stylish look. Very skilled and friendly staff.
Overall, great service, clean environment and polite team.
Highly recommended Lakme Salon Sion West for pedicure and haircut services! 👌✨

featured_reviews.name: sharvari jagtap
featured_reviews.review_text: Although Ms. Swara was very kind and polite in providing the services. The nail art is exceptionally wonderful when applied but after application on 2nd day itself the nail paint has started chipping off. The salon has charged so much but products used are not upto the mark.

featured_reviews.name: Rebecca Chan
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a wonderful experience at this salon. They were so flexible to fit me in, and my hair came out so great. Styled by Jayesh , would definitely recommend!

featured_reviews.name: P Nirwan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I got my hairs done by co. Salon
....very nice experience with shaan Sir
I'm so happy with results 😻✨

featured_reviews.name: Zarqua Farooqui
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent service at Lakme Salon Sion! Hair expert Shirin is truly skilled and understands exactly what the client wants. Skin expert swara gave a very relaxing and effective skin treatment. Both are friendly and professional. Totally satisfied with the experience.

featured_reviews.name: Sana Sayed
featured_reviews.review_text:
Loved the hair cut. It was my first time and the staff was really polite and suggested the best hair cut. Sam has done an amazing work with my hair.
Thankyou . Will surely be visiting again
